description: CONFIRMED mapped defect #4: after adding a 4th medicine (Salicylic Acid 12% Ointment, 1-0-1, 4 weeks) without re-saving, footer "Go to Pharmacy" fired no save request, triggered the browser "leave site" prompt, and navigated to /dashboard/pharmacy?patientId&doctorId&visitId; Pharmacy Billing loaded "Items from prescription: 3" - the new medicine is missing from the bill.
expected: Go to Pharmacy saves the prescription first (like Print does) and hands off the up-to-date Rx.
actual: Unsaved Rx changes silently not billed.
suggested_fix: Call saveBeforeExport() before navigating and pass prescriptionId; use router navigation.

description: CONFIRMED mapped defect #11: ticking "Refill stamp" prints "Refill eligible" on preview and PDF although the prescription has maxRefills = 0 and refills = [] (API). In the downloaded PDF the stamp is also clipped at the top-right page edge.
expected: Stamp only when refills are allowed (or show "No refills").
suggested_fix: Gate the stamp on maxRefills > 0; keep it inside the printable margin.

description: CONFIRMED mapped defect #10: the preview "Printer profile" select opens with zero options and there is no way to create a profile.
expected: Hidden until profiles exist, or a "Create profile" action.
suggested_fix: Hide the control or wire upsertPrinterProfile.

description: CONFIRMED mapped defect #12: "High contrast" in the preview adds body.high-contrast; after Close the whole app (sidebar, buttons, Branded toggle) stays high-contrast. The button exposes no pressed state (aria-pressed null).
expected: High contrast scoped to the preview and removed on close; toggle shows its state.
suggested_fix: Scope the class to the preview container; clean up on unmount; add aria-pressed.

description: Default template medicines ("Adapalene Gel 0.1%", "Benzoyl Peroxide Gel 2.5%") are free text not linked to the drug master: the builder shows "Stock: —", Pharmacy Billing shows "Not linked – link inventory before billing" for both and prices them as "Dosage: 1 TABLET" and 0/84 units, while the searched drug "Adapalene 0.1% Gel 15g" (stock 60) exists.
expected: Templates reference drug-master items so stock and billing work.
actual: Every template use needs manual linking at the counter.
suggested_fix: Store drugId in default templates (or resolve by name on apply).

description: After the pharmacy handoff, browser Back reopens the visit with the unsaved row restored from the local draft, but progress is "0% • 0 of 5" and the Prescription section is no longer marked though the Rx is saved on the server - Complete Visit (story step 18) cannot be reached without re-creating the prescription (plus vitals, photo, Save Labs).
expected: Section completion derived from server state (Rx exists → Prescription complete).
suggested_fix: Compute completed sections from saved data, or persist them in visit metadata and rehydrate.

description: Medication table columns are crushed at 1280px: "When" values break letter-by-letter ("Be/dti/me", "Aft/er/Lu/nc/h"), duration unit "WEEK/S", raw enum "ONCE_/DAILY", and "Rem/ove" buttons; the table also extends past the right edge (see F-401-06).
expected: Readable single-line cells; human labels ("Once daily").
suggested_fix: Give the table a min-width inside its own scroll container; map enums to labels.

description: Footer "Total items: 3 • Total qty: 0" even with Doxycycline 0-1-0 x 4 weeks (28 tablets) - quantity is never computed; the create toast says "1 medications" for a single item.
expected: Total qty reflects course quantity; correct pluralisation.
suggested_fix: Compute qty from frequency x duration for unit-dosed forms; pluralise.

description: Dashboard "Today's Appointments" rows (Priya Sharma 18:30 etc.) are not clickable and offer no Start Visit; status shows raw enum "IN_PROGRESS". Combined with F-401-01 (evening tiles not on the calendar) the doctor has no UI route from her day list to the visit.
expected: Rows open the appointment / Start Visit.
suggested_fix: Link rows to the visit deep link; humanise status.

description: Printout mixes frequency formats ("once daily" for template rows vs "0-1-0" for added rows), prints pack size in the drug name ("Doxycycline 100 mg Tablets (Strip of 10)"), prints a "Signature" caption with no signature, and silently includes a template chief complaint ("Acne lesions on face") the doctor never typed.
expected: Consistent dosing notation; clean drug names; no empty signature caption; template text visible in the form before print.
suggested_fix: Normalise frequency rendering; strip pack info; hide caption without signature.

description: Preview sidebar has three equally heavy primaries (green "Save Prescription", dark "Print", dark "Download PDF"), two "Close" buttons plus a dialog X, an Email button styled differently from its neighbours, and "PDF via WhatsApp" wrapping to two lines.
expected: Print as the single primary; one close.
suggested_fix: Demote Save/PDF to secondary, drop the extra Close.

description: At 390px the prescription builder content is 1400px wide inside a 390px main; only the first ~120px of the medicine column is visible.
suggested_fix: Stack the row fields into cards below md.

description: When the shared login throttle trips, the login form shows "ThrottlerException: Too Many Requests (Reference: …)".
expected: "Too many attempts - try again in a minute."
suggested_fix: Map 429 to friendly copy with retry-after.
